effects.name: working-store-recovery-state
effects.source: the working-tree Vouch store merge-git-stages is about to replace, read under the publication lock
effects.capture: whether it opens as a valid store whose verified history incorporates both index-stage heads (OURS and THEIRS), through predecessors and merge parents, and whose head is neither; captured only in the refusal

effects.name: working-store-rerun-refusal
effects.system: the working-tree Vouch store and the Git index
effects.detail: merge-git-stages refuses with git.already-recovered, writing nothing to the working store or the Git index, when the working store already holds a merge of the same index stages; otherwise it writes as before
